description: This file contains API utility functions for a frontend application, primarily responsible for fetching and processing dashboard data such as modules, overview metrics, and resource summaries from a backend API. It includes functions for URL resolution, JSON fetching, data normalization, and public interfaces for retrieving dashboard overview information.

methods.name: resolveBase()
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL by checking environment variables, heuristic URL construction, or default fallback.

methods.name: fetchJson(url, { credentials = 'omit' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a JSON response from the specified URL, handling authentication headers, organization IDs, and error processing.

methods.name: toArray(data)
methods.description: Normalizes different data shapes to an array, used to process API responses that may vary in structure.

methods.name: getModules()
methods.description: Public interface to retrieve modules overview for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints and deriving minimal data if needed.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics()
methods.description: Fetches consolidated metrics data for the dashboard overview, including total users and deployed applications.
